axis: Embodied stakes — felt, not described. Specific names, specific futures, specific people.

questions.pattern: \b(Gijs Zomer|Mike Rodgers|James Loehr|Hill family|the family|Joe Hill|William Hill|senior engineer|VP Operations)\b
questions.question: REQUIRED: ≥3 specific humans named in roles?
REQUIRED: 'your team / your engineers / your customers' appears ≥5 times?

questions.pattern: (\d+ hours? (a |per )(week|month)|engineers? (give|spend|waste) .+(hours?|time)|14[- ]day proposal cycle|600 hours|the .+ that retires next year)
questions.question: REQUIRED: a specific concrete workflow scene (engineers wasting time on docs, etc.)?

questions.pattern: (margin (compress|erodes)|the family business|the legacy|the moat closes|the retirement (cliff|wave)|Hill family.+(risk|concern|wealth))
questions.question: REQUIRED: specific consequence of failure named for a specific stakeholder?

patterns: \b(the future of work|industry transformation|paradigm shift|digital revolution|new normal)\b
questions.question: REQUIRED: no abstract stakes only ('the future of work', 'industry transformation')?
REQUIRED: future-state for HED resolved to specific numbers (Y3 $130M, etc.)?
REQUIRED: at least one customer-application named (fire truck, refuse, ag, defense)?

patterns: \b(a customer told us|industry leaders say|insiders report|sources say|on background)\b
questions.question: REQUIRED: no anonymous 'a customer told us' or 'industry leaders say'?
